purpose: React hook that manages the idle → pending → success|error → idle lifecycle for any async button action, with auto-reset after a configurable delay.
businessRules: A second trigger() call is a no-op while the state is 'pending' — prevents double-submission.
The auto-reset timer is cleared on unmount to avoid setState-on-unmounted-component warnings.
resetAfterMs controls how long success/error states are held before returning to idle (default 2000 ms).
Callers must pass a function that returns a Promise; the hook resolves success on fulfillment and error on rejection.
The hook does not catch or swallow errors — the error state signals that the caller's action threw/rejected.
Use FeedbackButton (src/components/shared/feedback-button.tsx) for the standard visual treatment; use useFeedback directly when you need custom rendering.
